scripts.test: sh -c 'if [ "$GIT_STUNTS_DOCKER" = "1" ]; then vitest run test/unit "$@"; else docker compose run --build --rm test npm test -- "$@"; fi' --
scripts.benchmark: sh -c 'if [ "$GIT_STUNTS_DOCKER" = "1" ]; then vitest bench test/benchmark "$@"; else docker compose run --build --rm test npm run benchmark -- "$@"; fi' --
